fact_text: The KSE-100 index moved up toward 91,000 points and then toward 92,000, with profit-taking appearing at several points along the way.

fact_text: The analyst said the index could move further toward 92,000 points, with the size of the expected policy-rate cut a key factor in how far it goes.

fact_text: The analyst said a 300 basis point cut at the 4 November 2024 decision would give the market a stronger lift than a 200 basis point cut.

fact_text: Lower interest rates reduce listed companies' financial charges, which the analyst said is a major earnings effect for many firms.

fact_text: The analyst observed that cost of goods sold is rising sharply across listed companies, which squeezes margins.

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer's nine-month results showed positive earnings, with costs rising less than at cement or chemical peers, according to the analyst.

fact_text: The analyst said Fatima's price-to-earnings multiple is somewhat better than those of Fauji Fertilizer and Engro Fertilizers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)

fact_text: Fatima paid a half-year dividend for the period to June 2024, and the analyst expected a third-quarter dividend to follow.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement's nine-month results were strong, and the analyst said its earnings could rise sharply if utilisation improves in the half-year starting January 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement's plants serve the Khushab, Mianwali, Ghazi Khan and Dera Ismail Khan districts, and its utilisation is low, so the analyst sees room for volume growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement's gross sales were about PKR 11 to 12 billion and net sales about PKR 7 billion, and the analyst said sales have stayed near that level for seven to eight quarters.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement has started using imported and local coal instead of national grid power for part of its energy, which the analyst said should lower its costs.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)

fact_text: The analyst estimated Pioneer Cement's annual cost savings at about PKR 10 billion from the shift away from national grid power, with part of the saving already visible.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'WARNING Don't Invest in PSX Stocks Without Knowing This. PIOC & FATIMA Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-10-30)
